answer: One lever: funding-path correlation. Each agent signs with its own key, but the ledger records where every identity's stake came from. A sybil fleet poses as a flock of independent sparrows, yet their capital all traces back to one wallet, a single ember of real funds. A correlation check acts like a falcon over that flock: it folds every identity sharing a funding root into one accrual cap, so the whole swarm earns only what one honest agent would. To escape it, the attacker must bankroll each mask from genuinely independent, aged capital, a cost that climbs linearly with every fake identity.
